svg.title: shem architecture
svg.desc: The Docker CLI builds OCI images and pushes or pulls them through a standard registry. Docker run reaches the shem containerd shim, which receives the image's root filesystem and drives the host. The shem CLI can drive the host directly. The Rust host provides Linux syscalls in container mode, or privileged instructions and devices in VM mode. A Unix socket connects it to the Python/PyTorch neural vCPU: CPU weights and register/memory state. A Rust reference interpreter is an alternative backend with the same snapshot format.

g.text: both vCPUs use the same snapshot format
